subject: Request for action on uncovered construction debris in Jaipur (JunkSnap site site_jpr_1)
body:
To the Commissioner, Jaipur Municipal Corporation.

Residents have reported uncovered construction debris in Jaipur, at 26.8530 N, 75.8156 E. Reports since 10 October 2026: 1. Reported by 1 resident; community verification in progress (2 of 10 people confirmed so far).
Blurred photos: https://d111111abcdef8.cloudfront.net/media/reports/rpt_jpr_1.jpg

The relevant provisions read:

Environment (Construction and Demolition) Waste Management Rules, 2025 (G.S.R. 219(E), 2 April 2025, in force 1 April 2026), rule 17(1):
"SAMPLE QUOTE for mock mode; the real text comes from the hashed official copy."

Environment (Construction and Demolition) Waste Management Rules, 2025 (G.S.R. 219(E), 2 April 2025, in force 1 April 2026), rule 9(1)(d):
"SAMPLE QUOTE for mock mode; the real text comes from the hashed official copy."

We request that the debris be covered or removed and that dust control measures be enforced.

This letter is filed by a resident. Copies go for attention to the MLA for Malviya Nagar and the MP for Jaipur.
